primary_outcome: the batch report the fixed driver prints follows SOP TM-07: blank levels, sample amounts and flags with CCV qualifiers, CCV recoveries and spike recoveries

obligations.contribution: readings come from the least-squares line with its intercept fitted

authority.anchor: its intercept fitted (not forced through the origin)

separability.rationale: the value feeds the reported amounts, flags or QC figures of the same batch report

obligations.discriminating_instance: standards on a line with a large intercept, and standards at concentration 1000, counts 0 and 10^9, is_counts 1000 and 10^9, only two different concentrations, and a slope of 2 x 10^-12
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: keep the fit through the origin

obligations.contribution: the blank level is the mean of the batch's blank results, every blank wherever it sits; with no result the SOP gives no rule and the shipped first-blank reading stands

authority.anchor: The blank level of an analyte is the mean of the batch's method-blank results

separability.rationale: the value feeds the reported amounts, flags or QC figures of the same batch report

obligations.discriminating_instance: blanks after the samples, non-detect blanks among results, and a batch whose blanks are all non-detects
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: average every blank reading, or use 0.0 when no blank is a result

obligations.contribution: the blank level comes off the reading before the dilution multiplies

separability.rationale: the value feeds the reported amounts, flags or QC figures of the same batch report

obligations.discriminating_instance: a non-zero blank level with dilutions 1, 10, 37 and 1000, and a reading of 10^4 at dilution 1000 (an amount of 10^7)
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: multiply the reading by the dilution and then subtract the blank level

obligations.contribution: ND, J and unflagged are judged on the corrected reading, J only below the loq

separability.rationale: the value feeds the reported amounts, flags or QC figures of the same batch report

obligations.discriminating_instance: corrected readings a hair either side of the mdl and the loq, and diluted samples whose amount crosses the mdl while the corrected reading does not
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: judge the flag on the amount, or add a tolerance to a limit

obligations.contribution: a CCV passes on its recovery rounded to one decimal, 90.0 to 110.0 inclusive; a run with a CCV on each side needs both to pass; otherwise the shipped nearest-earlier check stands

separability.rationale: the value feeds the reported amounts, flags or QC figures of the same batch report

obligations.discriminating_instance: recoveries of 90.0, 110.00000000000001, 110.04, 110.06, 89.96 and 89.94; runs before the first and after the last CCV
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: compare the unrounded recovery, or use the CCV on whichever side exists

obligations.contribution: spike recovery is (spike amount - parent amount) / added when both are results; otherwise the shipped calculation stands
